corrected_M14_screen.root_formula: d3=14-1.226869*1.5; basic60-degree thread geometry only. Actual root tolerance/notch and bought screw unknown.
corrected_M14_screen.qualification: External-load stress only. No bolt preload, prying, fatigue, locking, slip or thread-stripping acceptance inferred.

critical_gaps.specific_gap: No confirmed maximum service or parking torque for the exact purchased rotor/pad/caliper/chamber set. No selected validated anti-compounding circuit excludes simultaneous service and spring action.
critical_gaps.needed: Upper force-vs-pressure/stroke/tolerance curves at maximum normal and credible fault pressure; caliper transfer over adjustment/wear; maximum friction/effective-radius pair; minimum friction/force for holding separately; actual brake mass/CG and shock acceleration load cases.
critical_gaps.action: Freeze exact package and compute service, parking, combined/fault, reversed-torque and hot/cold envelope. Never use required stopping torque363.825Nm or GA connection limit10000Nm as actual maximum output.

critical_gaps.connection: 100mm keyed axle, split hub and rotor attachment
critical_gaps.specific_gap: Key projected flank stress is34.7222MPa/kNm on72mm effective length and8mm bearing depth; at10kNm it is347.22MPa. Shaft, hub and key each need contact allowables. Four M12 split screws have no solved half-hub equilibrium/preload/separation model; rotor8-bolt equal sharing is only an idealization.
critical_gaps.needed: Controlled rotor hub face/hat section; specified material/condition for all three key-contact members; actual keyway root/end radii; hub joint preload, thread engagement, contact and bolt-load model; complete wheelset bending/torque spectrum including carrier reactions and press fits.
critical_gaps.action: Analyze one keyed half, both flange halves and rotor as separate bodies. Do not credit collar friction or split-face friction without specified preload/geometry. Verify rotating-bending/keyway fatigue; pure unnotched torsion alone is insufficient. No speculative extra key or longer bolt until package loads/datum close.

critical_gaps.specific_gap: Static catalog margin does not establish seat rigidity or coasting suitability. Estimated minimum radial load1.98kN exceeds every outer-bearing reaction in the current50kg zero-torque probe. No controlled interference, split closure, roundness or residual clearance exists.
critical_gaps.needed: Supplier disposition for low-load coasting, actual speed/grease/cold starting; fits for100mm shaft/reducer and120mm reducer/inner ring and150mm housing seat; loaded seat stiffness, roundness and weld-distortion limits.
critical_gaps.action: Qualify actual mounted arrangement with SKF or select an arrangement suited to its duty. Do not add uncalculated preload or ballast merely to meet a generic minimum-load estimate.

critical_gaps.connection: Opposed AXK thrust stacks, covers and collars
critical_gaps.specific_gap: Nominal model has zero stack end clearance; calculated2.162kN thrust excludes thermal preload. Unloaded coasting axial force is nominally zero versus catalog minimum-load estimate0.340kN. Hard clamping is not a controlled preload solution.
critical_gaps.needed: Cold end-float/preload target and tolerance stack; differential thermal growth; support stiffness; controlled means of setting and checking end float or spring preload; minimum operating radial clearance; axial collar and M4/M6 retention verification.
critical_gaps.action: Set an explicit measured cold/hot axial arrangement with supplier approval. Check M4 cover bending/thread stripping and Ruland shaft finish/seating conditions against external plus thermal loads, not only link-derived thrust.

critical_gaps.specific_gap: C54 treats shear on a14mm plain shank and tensile area115mm2; the fine-thread specification requires correction. A30mm screw through12mm gives only18mm nominal penetration before tolerances, entry/runout and bottoming checks. Two outer holes retain only6.578mm free-edge ligament.
critical_gaps.needed: Exact screw drawing including thread runout/shear plane; measured available full-thread hole depth and entry; worst-case stack; OEM205-225Nm oiled tightening specification; plate/head contact, prying, hole bearing and breakout model using actual support webs. The primary GA also calls for an18mm wrench size and AlbionNJJ4163 screw reference; generic22mm-diameter circular-head representations do not establish the specified fastener.
critical_gaps.action: Use thread-root shear sensitivity until plain-shank placement is proven. Do not lengthen screws blindly. Replace arbitrary strip-bending probes with actual plate/contact/bolt analysis before approval.

critical_gaps.connection: Web/barrel, fork/barrel, frame-root and side-web welds
critical_gaps.specific_gap: Largest candidate6mm line-weld traction is149.024MPa at10kNm at web/barrel. Complete contact perimeter was assumed accessible and effective; same-side3-bolt load sharing and equal cheek sharing are assumptions. No parent-wall/local-buckling/fatigue capacity exists.
critical_gaps.needed: Specified base metals/filler, qualified weld procedure and actual weld extent; post-weld bearing-seat machining/inspection; plate/barrel shell and12mm C5 side-web local analysis including existing frame loads; weld fatigue detail and duty spectrum.
critical_gaps.action: Retain real extended webs and broader roots. Recalculate actual weld paths and supporting plates at confirmed combined load; add caliper/chamber gravity and shock inertia at measured CG. Parent metal may govern before gross HSS.

critical_gaps.specific_gap: Pin bending controls its nominal combined stress:225.49MPa at10kNm versus36.11MPa shear. Generic custom steel has no allowable. Cotter and5mm cross-hole/end ligament retain axial hardware but are not rated.
critical_gaps.needed: Pin grade/heat-treatment/finish, actual bearing pressure and clearances, fretting/fatigue and load direction; exact retaining-pin/washer specification; spherical-bearing supplier fit/articulation checks.
critical_gaps.action: Choose pin material only after required proof/fatigue margins are defined; retain central-load45mm support-span screening or replace with validated distributed contact model.

release_path: Freeze exact component set and controlled maximum service, parking and combined/fault forces/torques; define actual moving mass/CG, pressure protections and duty.
Agree criteria and specify materials, fits, axial clearance/preload, fastener grade/geometry and weld procedure. Resolve SKF minimum-load/seat application first.

Rerun global and local load paths at confirmed bounds, including split hub, caliper plate/bolts, local parent plates, full axle bending and fatigue. Revise only the member that fails a defined criterion.

Build one instrumented development assembly only after those details are reviewed. Verify assembly/end float, cold/hot drag, rotor runout, clamp retention and mount deflection at an agreed proof load; perform the defined thermal/cyclic test and inspect. A one-time proof test does not establish fatigue life.
Replicate the brake only after the first assembly evidence closes.

SKF_static_guidelines.fact: Roller static-factor guidance depends on load certainty and permitted permanent deformation: low certainty continuous motion >=2.5, >=3, >=4 for increasing deformation restraint; high certainty/no deformation uses3.

SKF_minimum_load.fact: Estimated minimum radial needle load0.02*C; needle thrust minimum0.0005*C0. Cold/viscous lubrication can increase demand.

SKF_fits.fact: Load direction, magnitude, seat stiffness, temperature and internal-clearance loss govern fits; discontinuous seats require distortion consideration.

SKF_life.fact: Basic roller L10=(C/P)^(10/3), in million revolutions at90% reliability. No vehicle acceptance life inferred.

M14_fine_thread.fact: M14x1.5 nominal tensile stress area125 mm2; not115 mm2 coarse-pitch area. Thread shear area requires actual root geometry.

WABCO_carrier_interface.verified_by: C55 structural agent independently rendered and read callout1 in the retained primary GA
WABCO_carrier_interface.fact: Six oiled M14x1.5 property10.9;18mm minimum thread engagement;205-225Nm tightening in specified1-6 order;10000Nm transferable carrier connection limit. No controlled tapped depth or hole-entry chamfer established.

package_updates.conclusion: Pressure rating and informational curves do not close maximum output. Keep existing0250 geometry; no force/torque cap is inferred.

concept_remediation.one_piece_120OD_100ID_sleeve: Cannot pass retained110mm wheel seat after wheel removal; the shaft shoulder still blocks assembly. No such substitution is approved.

continuous_outer_sleeve_over_split_inner.benefit: Continuous outer seat and seal-running cylinder can pass110mm wheel seat; uniform split inner adapter avoids five stepped reducer stages.
continuous_outer_sleeve_over_split_inner.unresolved: Thin outer-sleeve stiffness, both interface fits, radial collapse/roundness, axial race backing, creep, thermal clearance and full assembly. Concept only.

integral_axle_seats.benefit: Integral120mm journals remove split reducer interfaces;120mm bore components can pass110mm wheel seat to their seats.
integral_axle_seats.unresolved: New axle blank/drawing, transitions, whole-axle fatigue, bearing installation-force path and axial/seal arrangement. Concept only; not a drop-in retrofit.
